title: Vallmer Pack AG, three rivals
subtitle: Read on the public record
note: Vallmer Pack AG is an invented example company, a Swiss maker of packaging machines. Its three rivals are real Swiss companies read on the public record on the date shown, under invented names: Tessmer Pack AG, Orvanta Group AG and Brenvik Packaging Systems AG.

tries.label: The rivals, one by one
tries.source: Antevo Companies, Trademark and Strategy Radar, 25 Nov 2026. Sanctions: none of the three found on OFAC SDN, EU FSF, UK or SECO lists under its name.

items.name: Brenvik Packaging Systems AG
evidence: A call to creditors after a merger, published on 1, 2 and 3 May 2024: it took over another company
Signatories changed in July 2024 (5 in, 4 out), January 2025 (4 in, 1 out) and December 2025 (1 in, 1 out)
First marks under this name filed 3 December 2025 in Brazil and Canada, classes 7, 9 and 42, both pending

items.name: Tessmer Pack AG
evidence: Eight marks on two names in Australia, Canada, Israel and Singapore; seven registered, one pending, none lapsed
All in classes 7, 37 and 42; first filing 2009, last 12 December 2024
Register changed on 10 July 2025 and 11 May 2026

items.name: Orvanta Group AG
evidence: A holding company, entered in the register in 2018
Ten notices in all, the last two on 22 December 2025 and 11 May 2026
No trademark filings under its own name; marks may sit with another group company (not checked)

items.why: A new country or a new class in the next filing shows where a rival is going.

items.do: Watch each company file for register changes
items.why: Mergers, name changes and new signatories reach the official gazette before the press.

items.do: Read the notice text for this year’s changes
items.why: Two rivals’ registers changed on 11 May 2026; the notice says what changed.

items.do: Ask sales whether these rivals turn up in bids in Brazil, Canada or Singapore
items.why: Their filings point there; the order book says whether it matters.

sections.title: One rival has been reorganising
sections.verdict: Brenvik · a merger and new signatories
sections.so_what: A rival that merges and changes its signatories is rebuilding: read it as a sign of a bigger offer, not of trouble.
evidence: A call to creditors after a merger, published 1–3 May 2024
Signatory changes in July 2024, January 2025 and December 2025
Name changed in January 2020; purpose changed twice that year
sections.source: Antevo Companies, official gazette notices, read 25 Nov 2026

sections.title: New marks reach into software
sections.so_what: If its machines come with software of their own, the rivalry moves to the service around the machine, the same ground as a US service hub.
evidence: Two marks filed 3 December 2025, Brazil and Canada, both pending
Class 9 covers software and electronics; class 42 covers engineering and software services
Too few filings for a pattern: an absence of evidence, not a clean bill

sections.title: Tessmer files tightly, far from home
sections.so_what: A company that files tightly and carries every filing through protects what it sells; its four offices are where it chose to protect its names.
evidence: 100% of its class claims in classes 7, 37 and 42
7 of 7 decided filings registered
Last filing 12 December 2024

sections.title: The sector today
sections.so_what: The tariff list and German demand reach every Swiss maker in the field, rivals and this company alike.
evidence: US tariffs on the EU and others reported for this week, rates not yet published (high impact, rising)
German manufacturing surveys at 55 in November (medium impact, high likelihood)
sections.source: Antevo Executive Brief, business board of 25 Nov 2026

links.text: Brenvik merged in 2024, renewed its signatories through 2025 and filed its first marks abroad in December 2025: the register and the filings tell one story of a company rebuilding its offer.
Two rivals file in Canada, and the board reports US tariff plans this week: North America is where the competition and the levy meet.
